lines.text: $\cos$ always lies between $-1$ and $1$, so the $1.5\cos(\cdot)$ term lies between $-1.5$ and $1.5$.
The period of $\cos ct$ is $\frac{2\pi}{c}$. It is the time between two successive high tides: 02:00 to 14:34.
